Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://www.periyaruniversity.ac.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 18-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Periyar University Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Guest Faculty post at Periyar University is 18 August 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Guest Faculty at Periyar University?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Guest Faculty position in Energy Science and Technology at Periyar University for the 2026 recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for the Guest Faculty post at Periyar University?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Guest Faculty position at Periyar University will receive a salary of Rs. 30,000 per month. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Periyar University Guest Faculty recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it to the specified address.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications for Guest Faculty at Periyar University?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D/M.E./M.Tech in a respective or related subject such as Mechanical, Electrical and Electronics, Energy Science, or other specified fields.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for Periyar University Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Periyar University Guest Faculty recruitment. The application is free.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Guest Faculty at Periyar University?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Guest Faculty position at Periyar University primarily involves an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. When is the interview date for Guest Faculty at Periyar University?
faq.answer: The interview for the Guest Faculty position at Periyar University is scheduled for 19 August 2026. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for exact timings and venue.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Periyar University located?
faq.answer: Periyar University is located in Salem, Tamil Nadu, with the pincode 636011. It is a state university providing higher education.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of Periyar University?
faq.answer: The official website for Periyar University is https://www.periyaruniversity.ac.in. Candidates can visit this site for more details and to download the application form.
